name: anime
description: A lightweight JavaScript animation library with a simple yet powerful API.
licenseNote: MIT — use anime.js in any commercial product with no obligations beyond keeping the copyright notice in the library file.
whatIsIt: anime.js is a tiny JavaScript library that animates anything on a webpage — numbers, CSS properties, SVG, DOM attributes — with a single clean API. You describe what to animate, how long, and with what easing, and it handles the rest.
whereToUse: Hero text that types or fades in letter by letter
SVG illustrations that draw themselves on scroll
Number counters that count up when visible
Micro-interactions on buttons and cards
Dashboard widgets that animate between states
setup: Install: `npm install animejs --save` (v3) or `npm install animejs@4` for the new ESM version
Import: `import anime from 'animejs'` (v3) or `import { animate } from 'animejs'` (v4)
Animate any element by passing a CSS selector + target values + duration
Add easing and delays for sequenced, staggered animations

name: pocketbase
description: Open-source backend in one file: database, auth, files, and realtime API.
licenseNote: MIT — free for commercial use, including hosted products. You own your data.
whatIsIt: PocketBase is an entire backend — SQLite database, auth, file storage, realtime subscriptions, and an auto-generated REST API — packaged in a single executable file. No servers to babysit, no vendor lock-in.
whereToUse: MVP backends for client apps
Internal tools for small businesses
Mobile app backends without the cloud bill
Any project where Supabase/Firebase costs don't make sense yet
setup: Download the binary for your OS from pocketbase.io (or use the Dockerfile below)
Run `./pocketbase serve --dev` and open the admin UI at 127.0.0.1:8090/_/
Create collections (tables) and auth rules in the admin UI — the REST + realtime API is generated automatically
Deploy: any $5 VPS, `./pocketbase serve` behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS

configFiles.code:
FROM alpine:3.20
ARG PB_VERSION=0.28.4
ADD https://github.com/pocketbase/pocketbase/releases/download/v${PB_VERSION}/pocketbase_${PB_VERSION}_linux_amd64.zip /tmp/pb.zip
RUN unzip /tmp/pb.zip -d /pb && chmod +x /pb/pocketbase
EXPOSE 8090
CMD ["/pb/pocketbase", "serve", "--http=0.0.0.0:8090"]

name: LibreChat
description: Self-hosted AI chat with all the model providers, plugins, and multi-user support.
licenseNote: MIT — free for commercial use, including offering it as a hosted service.
whatIsIt: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone you host yourself: multiple AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, local models via Ollama), multi-user accounts, plugins, web search, and document chat — all in one polished interface.
whereToUse: Private ChatGPT for teams that care about data control
AI chat product for a niche (legal, medical, dev docs)
A polished front-end for local LLMs
Multi-provider chat for agencies and consultants
setup: Clone: `git clone https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat.git`
Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and add your API keys (e.g. OpenAI, or point at Ollama for local models)
Run `docker compose up -d` — the app and its database come up together
Open http://localhost:3080, register the first account, and enable the providers you configured

configFiles.code:
services:
  api:
    image: ghcr.io/danny-avila/librechat-api:latest
    restart: always
    env_file: .env
    depends_on: [mongo, meilisearch]
  client:
    image: ghcr.io/danny-avila/librechat-client:latest
    ports: ['3080:3080']
  mongo:
    image: mongo:6
  meilisearch:
    image: getmeili/meilisearch:latest

name: umami
description: Simple, privacy-first, open-source web analytics — the Google Analytics alternative without cookies.
licenseNote: MIT — free for commercial use, including selling hosted instances.
whatIsIt: Umami is a self-hosted web analytics tool: page views, referrers, and events without cookies or personal data collection — making GDPR headaches mostly disappear. It's what you install when clients ask 'can we track visitors without the Google stuff?'

setup: Deploy the official Docker image with a Postgres or MySQL database (compose file below)

configFiles.code:
services:
  umami:
    image: ghcr.io/umami-software/umami:latest
    ports: ['3000:3000']
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://umami:umami@db:5432/umami
      UMAMI_SECRET: ${UMAMI_SECRET}
    depends_on: [db]
  db:
    image: postgres:16
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: umami
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: umami
